translation.name: Biblica® Wɔnhia ɛho kwamma nwoma Asante Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content.text: Ao Awurade, nka mʼanim wɔ wʼabofuo mu
na ntwe mʼaso wɔ wʼabufuhyeɛ mu.
Wo bɛmma ahwire me mu,
na wo nsa adwerɛ me.
Wʼabofuhyeɛ no enti, ahoɔden biara nni me mu;
me bɔne enti, me nnompe ahodwo.
Mʼafɔdie amene me
te sɛ adesoa a emu yɛ duru dodo.
Mʼakuro bɔn na aporɔ
ɛsiane me bɔne mu agyimisɛm enti.
Makoto na wɔabrɛ me ase;
da mu nyinaa menantenante twa agyaadwoɔ.
Mʼakyi dompe mu yea boro so:
ahoɔden biara nni me onipadua mu.
Mabrɛ na mapɛkyɛ koraa.
Mʼakoma mu yea ma me si apinie.
Ao Awurade, deɛ merehwɛ anim nyinaa da wʼanim;
mʼapinisie nhintaa wo.
Mʼakoma bɔ paripari, na mʼahoɔden asa
mpo mʼaniwa aduru sum.
Mʼapirakuro enti me nnamfonom ne mʼayɔnkofoɔ mmɛn me;
mʼafipamfoɔ twe wɔn ho firi me ho.
Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔkum me no sum me mfidie,
wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔha me no di me sɛeɛ ho nkɔmmɔ.
Ɛda mu nyinaa wɔdwene nnaadaasɛm ho.
Mete sɛ ɔsotifoɔ a ɔnte asɛm,
mete sɛ mumu a ɔntumi nkasa.
Mayɛ sɛ obi a ɔnte asɛm,
deɛ nʼano ntumi mma mmuaeɛ.
Ao Awurade, meretwɛn wo;
Ao Awurade me Onyankopɔn, wobɛgye me so.
Mekaa sɛ, “Mma wɔn ani nnye;
anaa mma wɔnhoahoa wɔn ho wɔ me nan a awatiri no enti.”
Mereyɛ mahwe ase,
na me yea da so wɔ me mu.
Meka me mfomsoɔ kyerɛ;
me bɔne hyɛ me so.
Bebree na wɔyɛ mʼatamfoɔ;
wɔn a wɔtane me kwa no dɔɔso.
Wɔn a wɔde bɔne tua me papa so ka no
bɔ me ahohora ɛberɛ a mereyɛ papa.
Ao, Awurade nnya me.
Ao me Onyankopɔn, nkɔ akyiri!
Bra ntɛm bɛboa me,
Awurade, mʼAgyenkwa.
Wɔde ma ɔdwomkyerɛfoɔ no. Yedutun.
